clevedon.snapshot: Clevedon sits in the North Somerset full-fibre build, and its telecoms trade runs two ways. The build contractors and cabling firms putting crews across the town tend to run trade accounts and kit whole teams in branded workwear, while the ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. We run both routes side by side, serving the fleet and the single installer alike across Clevedon and the wider coast.
clevedon.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Clevedon and North Somerset
s1loc: Clevedon is well into its full-fibre build. Openreach has pushed fibre-to-the-premises across the town as part of a wider North Somerset programme, Bath-based alt-net Truespeed has added Clevedon to its fibre-to-the-premises plan, and Virgin Media is layered on top, with Project Gigabit work reaching the harder spots out toward Yatton and Kenn. Engineers from the major fibre and mobile networks work the streets and cabinets across districts like Old Church Road, Hill Road, East Clevedon, Walton and the seafront, with civils crews and delivery partners trenching and pulling fibre right across the town.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a steady commercial scene. Structured-cabling and CCTV installers wire offices, units and warehouses in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre across the Hither Green Trading Estate and Kenn Road Business Park near Junction 20 of the M5, the Tweed Road industrial estate and the 5C Business Centre on Strode Road, with multi-site work running out toward Portishead. The trade runs from contractors cabling whole office blocks to one-van installers fitting a single shopfront camera, and all of them need hard-wearing branded workwear for work across the town's premises.
